INBOX_LEDGER_UNAVAILABLE: The Action Inbox ledger could not be read or written, so the request was neither claimed nor run.
None; nothing ran. Retry the request with the same idempotency key.
INBOX_SCHEMA_NOT_READY: The V7 database is not ready for the Action Inbox tables (row format or privileges).
Run inbox-schema-check and fix what it reports.
INBOX_SCHEMA_TABLES_EXIST: One of the four Action Inbox tables already exists, so nothing was applied.
Look at the existing table before anything else.
INBOX_SCHEMA_VERIFY_FAILED: The tables were created but did not read back as planned (columns or rows).
Inspect the tables; nothing is deleted automatically.
FOLLOWUP_SCHEMA_NOT_READY: The V7 database is not ready for the Followup tables (row format, key size or privileges).
Run followup-schema-check and fix what it reports.
FOLLOWUP_SCHEMA_TABLES_EXIST: One of the five Followup tables already exists, so nothing was applied.
Look at the existing table before anything else.
FOLLOWUP_SCHEMA_VERIFY_FAILED: The Followup tables were created but did not read back as planned (columns or rows).
Inspect the tables; nothing is deleted automatically.
FOLLOWUP_STORE_UNAVAILABLE: The Followup state store could not be read or written, so the batch was rolled back and the last known-good state and cursor are unchanged.
None; nothing was kept. Retry the same batch.
FOLLOWUP_READBACK_MISMATCH: A Followup thread did not read back as written, so the batch was rolled back and the cursor did not advance.
Inspect the Followup tables and the writer; nothing is deleted automatically.
